name: Uncertainty Consumer
summary: Consumes deterministic uncertainty scores derived from aggregate counts and coverage state.
description: Uses uncertainty.score to convert bounded counts, coverage state, and pending-reference facts into one reason-coded uncertainty score. Needs explicit uncertainty that remains tied to supplied evidence boundaries rather than hidden heuristic workflow behavior.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes a scored uncertainty result from aggregate facts, rather than the aggregate facts themselves.
Converts coverage and count facts into a bounded uncertainty score, rather than classifying the completeness state of a coverage window.
